Service_Hint: Manage the SwiftList search backend service.
Service_ErrorTitle: Unable to connect to background service
Service_ErrorStats: Background service is not running or not installed. Please click the button to install and start it.
Service_InstallingStats: This usually takes a few seconds, please wait.
Service_AboutDesc: The SwiftList background service runs continuously as a Windows system service. It performs high-performance NTFS MFT scans, real-time USN change monitoring, and local drive index maintenance without blocking the user interface thread. The status updates here in real-time.
Service_Adv1Desc: — Remains silent when idle with a minimal memory footprint
Service_Adv2Desc: — Instantly captures and updates file changes using USN logs
Service_Adv3Desc: — Starts automatically with Windows, ready before you open search
Local_Hint: Select the local drives to include in SwiftList, view index status, and rebuild manually.
Local_Policy1Desc: Fast loading of historical index files for instant search response.
Local_Policy2Desc: Silently compares changes and maintains the local index cache.
Local_Policy3Desc: Utilizes USN journal to capture creation, deletion, and modification in seconds.
Network_Hint: Select the mapped network drives to include in SwiftList. Network indexes are stored locally, independent of MFT.
Network_Desc1: Only mapped network drives with a drive letter (e.g. Z:\) are supported. Raw UNC paths will not be scanned.
Network_Desc2: Network indexes are built by the App in the current user session; they are periodically saved to cache, and completed sections are instantly searchable.
Exclusions_Hint: Exclusions apply both to local search results and network drive indexes. Network indexes will refresh after applying.
Exclusions_PathCardDesc: Enter full path or environment variable path, e.g. D:\Cache, Z:\temp, %ProgramData%. The directory and its subfolders will be excluded.
Exclusions_GlobCardDesc: Exclude glob wildcard patterns. Supports: * matches any characters in filename (excluding directory separator); ? matches a single character; ** matches subdirectories recursively. E.g. *.tmp to filter temporary files; **\node_modules\** recursively filters node module folders; bin\** excludes all files under bin.
Exclusions_RegexCardDesc: Exclude regular expression patterns for advanced filename/path filtering (performs implicit partial matching). E.g. ^\. excludes hidden items starting with dot; ~$ excludes Office temporary lock files; \.git\ excludes Git folders at any depth.
Exclusions_AboutDesc1: For local NTFS drives, exclusions are applied during the search output stage from the MFT cache.
Exclusions_AboutDesc2: For network drives, excluded items are skipped directly during the folder scanning process.

About_Desc3: This software is a stable release version designed to enhance the Windows experience, featuring high-performance search and minimal system resource footprint.
About_Desc4: Local disks index using MFT/USN; Network drives index via user-mode scanning, caching, and listening.
